headline: Asian Games champion shot putter Balwinder Dhaliwal has passed away at the age of 67, prompting tributes from the Indian athletics community and officials.
India will host eleven major sporting events over the next six months, a strategic move aimed at strengthening the nation’s bid to stage the 2036 Olympic Games.
The official Commonwealth Games 2026 website publishes India’s comprehensive medals tally, listing all gold, silver and bronze medals won by Indian athletes in Glasgow.
